title: Rick M NDE 4994
content: Being Native American, I don't have a view of your heaven. No white light for me, or heavenly beings. What happened to me was very real, even as funny as it may sound! On February 2, 2009, I was rushed to the hospital after going for three weeks and under-going all kinds of tests. I even had my duodenal ulcer cauterized. I was told to go home again for the fourth time. What the doctors never checked was the artery attached to the duodenal. By the time I got home, it had ruptured. By the time the emergency medical technicians got me to the hospital, I had flat lined once. When they resuscitated me, I woke up with tubes all over the place. I had one right in my chest! There was blood all over! They knocked me out, and I flat lined again in surgery. During all this, I went to a place that was in the stars. At first, my friend Kuauhtli reached out and took me by the hand. Kuauhtli is a Peyote Road Man, who does ceremonies all over the world. He is also a twenty year Sun Dancer, who has given his flesh for twenty years. Kuauhtli led me inside a big yellow school bus. I looked around like where are we going? All Kuauhtli did was smile. There were no words spoken. When we entered the school bus, the interior had transformed to a Peyote Ceremony, and we were in a tepee. There were many Elders sitting around the Sacred Fire. Some looked to be very old. Some I recognized! I was amazed! I had just walked into a school bus, and now I was in a Peyote Ceremony! I went to look out of the windows, and we were in the cosmos!!! I touched the window and something outside touched back! I could feel the pressure, and we were floating in space, having a Peyote Ceremony!!! I was loving it! I had never felt such peace before in my life. There was never any talk of death, only the Elders singing their songs. Then I was in the intensive care unit, with tubes all over the place. I was told I was given thirteen units of blood. I spent nine days in their intensive care unit.

arrival.other_being_detail: Friend Kuauhtli (a Peyote Road Man and Sun Dancer) took him by the hand and led him into a big yellow school bus that transformed into a peyote ceremony in a tepee; many Elders were present around a Sacred Fire.

environment.environment_other_detail: A big yellow school bus transformed into the interior of a peyote ceremony inside a tepee; many Elders around a Sacred Fire; outside the windows was the cosmos/stars, floating in space.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Ruptured artery attached to the duodenal area after duodenal ulcer cauterization; flatlined once before hospital arrival and again in surgery.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience begins directly in a cosmic/ceremonial environment with a friend/guide and Elders; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; then he finds himself back in ICU.

I touched the window and something outside touched back!” “I had never felt such peace before in my life.”
